newsitem.title: CHILE: Cenbank, Banco de Chile sign debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Cenbank, Banco de Chile sign debt deal.

text.p: Chile's central bank and the Banco de Chile have signed a pact allowing the bank to repay $1.6 billion debt in installments over the next 40 years.

"At 1230 today we signed an agreement with the central bank modifying the bank's subordinated debt contract and puting an end to the issue of the Banco de Chile's subordinated debt obligations," said Banco de Chile president Adolfo Rojas.
The bank was one of the last to strike a deal with the central bank over the debt which was incurred when the central bank bailed out private banks during a financial crisis in the early 1980s.

The agreements have proved controversial. Former central bank governor Roberto Zahler resigned mid-year after a disagreement with the bank's board over the terms of the deals which he considered too generous to the private banks.
